title: Collection hub — structure
question: Event hub is quiet header + peer tabs + Details overview; deep edit in drawers. Collection today is one legacy page (inline edit, Events / Recurring tabs, add/remove). How should the collection detail hub compose inside that same world?

options.label: Details · Events · Settings
options.thesis: Same quiet header and overview-led Details as the event hub. Events owns membership (one-off + recurring lists). Settings holds privacy and delete.
options.viewport: ← Collections · title · Collection page. Tabs: Details (preview + description + share) · Events (flush lists + Add) · Settings (privacy + danger). Edit / Change photo / Add open EventHubPanel drawers.
options.risk: Three tabs for a thinner entity than a session — Settings may feel sparse.

options.label: Details-only stage
options.thesis: No peer tabs. One Details stage: overview card on top, then membership lists (events + recurring) flush below — Edit / Change photo / Add / Privacy still open panels.
options.viewport: Quiet header + Collection page. Scroll: overview → Events list → Recurring list. Deep work in drawers only.
options.risk: Long scroll on large collections; less parallel to event hub’s tab grammar.

options.label: Events-first hub
options.thesis: Land on Events (membership is the daily job). Details is a peer tab for cover, copy, and share; Settings for privacy/delete.
options.viewport: Same header. Default tab Events with Add primary. Details overview for listing identity.
options.risk: Diverges from event hub’s Details-first landing; organisers may miss collection identity.
